messages:
Sam - Support: FYI ticket from BrightLeaf — they say sales tax was charged on invoice INV-2026-0897 even though they submitted a WA reseller certificate. customer attached PDF. Can finance check whether we should issue credit note? link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0897
Katie - CS: attaching copy of the reseller cert they uploaded to the portal earlier today. billing contact says their HQ is in WA, billing address on file currently shows CA because their billing dept is in San Diego. they insist they're tax-exempt for WA sales.
Maria - Finance: Thanks. Quick Qs: did the tax get calculated by Stripe using billing or shipping address? also do we have tax ids in metadata for this customer?
Leo - Billing: Our current tax-origin logic uses the billing address by default unless customer is tax_exempt flag is set. I pulled the invoice: tax_total = $142.35, tax_rates applied = CA state sales 7.25% (tax_rate id tr_CA_720). Customer metadata shows `reseller_cert_uploaded=true` but we never set `tax_exempt=true`.
Emma - Legal: Note: even with a reseller certificate, nexus matters. If BrightLeaf has CA nexus (e.g., employees or a sales rep there), CA tax could still be valid. Need to confirm presence of nexus. If they truly have WA-only operations and a valid WA resale cert, we should refund the tax.
Sam - Support: Customer insists no CA nexus — they do contract work remotely but no office, no employees in CA. They supplied the WA resale form with tax id 123-45-6789. Asking for full refund of sales tax and corrected invoice.
Ops Oncall: I queried Stripe: invoice INV-2026-0897 shows `customer.address` = {"city":"San Diego","region":"CA"} and `customer.metadata.reseller_state=WA`. We didn't set `tax_exempt` for the customer. Snippet: ```json
{"id":"cus_01G...","address":{"line1":"...","city":"San Diego","region":"CA","country":"US"},"metadata":{"reseller_state":"WA","reseller_uploaded":"true"}}
```
Maria - Finance: Proposed action: 1) Request final signed resale cert (we have upload but need signature + tax id verification). 2) If legal confirms no CA nexus, issue credit note for tax_total ($142.35) and refund that portion. 3) Update customer record: set `tax_exempt=true` and add note to prevent future mis-taxing; set invoice origin to shipping address or `tax_origin=WA` override.
Emma - Legal: I'll review the resale cert and ask for confirmation email from customer that they have no nexus in CA. If any sign of CA nexus, we can't issue refund. Otherwise I approve credit note.
Stripe-bot: Created draft credit note CN-34721 for INV-2026-0897 (amount: $142.35) — status: draft. https://dashboard.stripe.com/credit_notes/CN-34721
Leo - Billing: Steps for Finance Ops to finalize: - attach verified cert to customer file, - in Stripe set `tax_exempt=true` and add metadata `tax_origin=WA`, - finalize CN-34721 and issue refund for tax portion, - reissue corrected invoice INV-2026-0897-R1 with zero tax. I'll prepare a brief how-to for the finance team.
Maria - Finance: I'll process once Legal confirms. If approved, CN will be finalized today and refund initiated (3-5 business days for the refund). Also will add ticket in our backoffice to reconcile tax reporting for Q1.
Sam - Support: Customer just responded: "Confirming we have no employees or physical presence in CA. We sent signed WA resale cert attached." They gave permission to proceed. :thumbsup:
Emma - Legal: Got the signed cert. No CA nexus found from our quick check. OK to proceed.
Maria - Finance: Finalizing CN-34721 now and setting refund. I'll post confirmation and refund txn id here when available.
Ops Oncall: Filing a product follow-up: switch tax lookup order to prefer `reseller_state` metadata when present OR prompt CS if billing address disagrees with reseller_state. Filed as PBI-6121.
Sam - Support: Thanks team — will update customer and close support ticket after refund confirmed.
Maria - Finance: Refund processed: txn ref REF-981233, should settle in 3 business days. Reissued corrected invoice INV-2026-0897-R1 (link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0897-R1). Closing on our side after reconciliation.
